name: io.github.mattoddie/bluelink-mcp
title: Hyundai Bluelink / Kia Connect
description: Check your Hyundai or Kia's charge, range, locks and location, pre-heat it and manage charging.

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: A named volume for the login token cache, so each session doesn't log in from scratch.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Run over stdio. The image defaults to HTTP.

environmentVariables.name: BLUELINK_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: The email address you log in to the Bluelink, Kia Connect or Genesis Connect app with.

environmentVariables.name: BLUELINK_PIN
environmentVariables.description: Your 4-digit app PIN. Europe and Canada need it for commands; reads work without it.

environmentVariables.name: BLUELINK_REGION
environmentVariables.description: Where your account was created. europe includes the UK; try europe-cci if europe fails.

environmentVariables.name: BLUELINK_BRAND
environmentVariables.description: hyundai (Bluelink), kia (Kia Connect, formerly UVO) or genesis (Genesis Connect).

environmentVariables.name: BLUELINK_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Allow commands to the car: lock, climate, charging, charge limits and hazard lights.

environmentVariables.name: BLUELINK_ALLOW_UNLOCK
environmentVariables.description: Also allow unlocking, after you confirm each time. Needs BLUELINK_ALLOW_WRITES.

environmentVariables.name: BLUELINK_ALLOW_LOCATION
environmentVariables.description: Share where the car is parked. This reveals where you live, work and park.

environmentVariables.name: BLUELINK_AUDIT_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Record every command as JSON lines: stderr, or a path in the container such as /data/audit.jsonl.
